content:
Hello, and I just would like to say that I know that the affinity system was changed, but in all honesty, it made gaining affinity more difficult, especially for characters that don’t have strong exalts. A primary reason for this is that the scaling of arithmetica used and cards played isn’t linear to the affinity gained, and the shifts make it so that an extremely short stage with arithmetica discount gimmick can cause an entire team to gain an overall of 0 affinity across the board. In addition to this, I did some math, and using an estimated duration and affinity gained from the playerbase, it can take anywhere from ~~25 days to 250+ days~~ **incorrect, see lower comments** of raw affinity farming to get a character from affinity level 15 to affinity level 20 with this new system, assuming that no breaks are taken. 
There are a lot of players who care about these characters and love them, so I would really like to ask for a reversion or revision of the current system to make it comfortable again for many players. <:Horla_shy:1468259514091573350>
